template.description: Exact form code. Matching is case-insensitive and ignores spaces and hyphens.

version.description: Exact template version. Required when more than one trusted version matches a code.

workflows.printBulkCsv: Open the template in a browser, choose Print CSV, select the completed CSV, and use the browser print dialog.

privacy.browserProcessing: Local files are processed in the browser and are not uploaded by the application workflow.
privacy.externalAgent: Data supplied to an external agent is subject to that agent's data-handling policy.
